sections.title: MIDDLE ATLANTIC
sections.text: REMNANTS OF TROPICAL SYSTEM BILL WILL PROGRESS ACROSS KY INTO WV DURING THE DAY AND DEAMPLIFY AS IT ENCOUNTERS STRONGER WLY FLOW ACROSS THE OH VALLEY. LATEST SHORT-RANGE GUIDANCE SUGGESTS DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL INCREASE MARKEDLY ACROSS THE MIDDLE ATLANTIC AS 30KT+ 500MB SWLY FLOW TRANSLATES ACROSS ERN TN INTO VA. VERY MOIST CONDITIONS WILL BE PRESENT ACROSS THIS REGION AHEAD OF SHORT WAVE WITH PW VALUES AOA 2 INCHES. SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD EASILY DEVELOP/INTENSIFY BY MID DAY ACROSS THIS REGION AS ANY BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO DESTABILIZATION. GUSTY WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH CONVECTION THAT EVOLVES EARLY IN THE PERIOD. WITH TIME WEAK SFC LOW SHOULD PROGRESS EAST OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTO VA AND LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS EXPECTED TO BACK IN RESPONSE TO THIS EVOLUTION. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST SHEAR PROFILES BECOME MORE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES LATER IN THE AFTERNOON/EVENING AS SHEAR INCREASES IN LOWEST 3KM.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: EARLY THIS MORNING...MATURING MCS IS PROGRESSING ESEWD ACROSS CNTRL SD WITH SUBSTANTIAL/EXPANDING PRECIP SHIELD STRETCHING FROM SCNTRL ND TO NEAR THE NEBRASKA BORDER. THIS ACTIVITY IS PROGRESSING AT ROUGHLY 35KT AND SHOULD MIGRATE INTO NWRN IA BY SUNRISE. WHILE THIS ACTIVITY COULD BE SEVERE AT 12Z IT/S NOT CLEAR WHETHER THIS ACTIVITY WILL DISSIPATE BEFORE DIURNAL HEATING CONTRIBUTES TO REINTENSIFICATION DURING THE AFTERNOON HOURS. WEAK HEIGHT FALLS WILL AFFECT THIS REGION DURING THE DAY WITH LEADING EDGE OF PRIMARY COLD FRONTAL SURGE EXPECTED TO EXTEND FROM WRN MN...SWWD INTO ERN NEB AT 18Z...THEN INTO CNTRL IA BY EARLY EVENING. IF CONVECTIVE DEBRIS IS NOT TOO SIGNIFICANT IT APPEARS BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO SUBSTANTIAL DESTABILIZATION WITH MUCAPE APPROACHING 4000 J/KG JUST SOUTH OF REMNANT MCS CLOUD SHIELD. AFTERNOON CONVECTION THAT EVOLVES AHEAD OF COLD FRONT SHOULD BE SUFFICIENTLY SHEARED FOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AND VERY LARGE HAIL IS EXPECTED...IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALSO SUGGEST ISOLATED TORNADOES MAY EVOLVE...ESPECIALLY IF CONVECTIVE MODE REMAINS FAVORABLY DISCRETE. TSTMS THAT EVOLVE OVER IA SHOULD PROPAGATE TOWARD NRN IL AS LLJ V

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SEASONALLY STRONG WLY FLOW WILL EXTEND ACROSS WY DURING THE AFTERNOON WITH 50KT+ 500MB SPEEDS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS INTO THE HIGH PLAINS BY 21/00Z. STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING...ESPECIALLY ACROSS THE DAKOTAS INTO NERN WY MAY CONTRIBUTE TO ISOLATED MARGINALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...THOUGH MOISTURE IS EXPECTED TO BE SUBSTANTIALLY LESS THAN VALUES OBSERVED OVER THIS REGION FRIDAY. EVEN SO...THERE APPEARS TO BE SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY FOR A FEW STRONG STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING GUSTY WINDS OR HAIL. ..DARROW/ROGERS.. 06/20/2015

WIDELY SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WITH A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES MAY OCCUR LATER TODAY FROM THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TO MID ATLANTIC COAST.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE PRIMARY BELT OF POLAR WESTERLIES WILL REMAIN CONFINED TO THE NRN TIER OF STATES WITH A SERIES OF LOW-AMPLITUDE PERTURBATIONS EMBEDDED WITHIN THIS HIGH-MOMENTUM AIR STREAM. PERHAPS THE MOST NOTABLE FEATURE WITH RESPECT TO DIURNALLY ENHANCED TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS A VORTICITY MAXIMUM WHICH WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE NRN PLAINS INTO UPPER GREAT LAKES. ELSEWHERE...THE DEEP-LAYER CIRCULATION ASSOCIATED WITH T.D. BILL WILL DEVELOP ENEWD FROM THE LOWER OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC COAST. AT THE SURFACE...A COLD FRONT PRESENTLY FROM THE ERN DAKOTAS TO CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WILL ADVANCE EWD/SEWD INTO THE MIDWEST. THIS FRONT AND PERHAPS AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LEFT OVER FROM AN OVERNIGHT MCS WILL BE THE FOCUS FOR RENEWED STORM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY.

sections.title: MIDWEST THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: IN THE WAKE OF THE EARLY-DAY STORMS PASSING THROUGH NRN IA AND SRN MN...DAYTIME HEATING...STEEPENING MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND INCREASING BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE WILL YIELD A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS BY AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE APPROACHING 2500-3500+ J/KG. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE --BOTH CONVECTION-PERMITTING AND PARAMETRIZED-- INDICATE SOME DEGREE OF VARIABILITY IN SPECIFICALLY WHERE AND WHEN SURFACE-BASED STORMS WILL INITIATE LATER TODAY. IN GENERAL...IT APPEARS THAT THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF THE ABOVE-MENTIONED SHORT-WAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE UPPER MS VALLEY WILL COMBINE WITH LOW-LEVEL UPLIFT ALONG THE COLD FRONT AND/OR RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY TO INITIATE STORMS BY MID TO LATE AFTERNOON OVER PORTIONS OF CNTRL/ERN IA INTO SWRN WI AND NWRN IL. THE COMBINATION OF STRONG INSTABILITY AND 40-50 KT OF WLY DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL BE QUITE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AS THE INITIAL STORM MODE WITH VERY LARGE HAIL BEING THE PRIMARY HAZARD. TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE OVERALL THREAT DEPENDENT ON: 1/ THE EVOLUTION OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY REMNANT FROM THE CURRENT STORMS OVER NRN IA...AND 2/ HOW QUICKLY CONVECTIVE MODE TRANSITIONS TO LINEAR. sections.text: BANDS OF STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS HAVE CONTINUED TO REGENERATE THROUGH MID/LATE MORNING ACROSS PORTIONS OF EAST-CENTRAL IA WITH SOME REINFORCING IMPACTS ON OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING. THERE IS AT LEAST SOME POSSIBILITY THAT THESE ONGOING/INITIALLY ELEVATED STORMS COULD GRADUALLY BECOME SURFACE-BASED...BUT A MORE PROBABLE SCENARIO SHOULD BE FOR THESE STORMS TO SOMEWHAT DIMINISH WITH SUBSEQUENT/MORE ROBUST SURFACE-BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING IN VICINITY OF AN EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD COLD FRONT...PARTICULARLY NEAR WHERE IT INTERSECTS PRIOR OUTFLOW/EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT ACROSS IA/IMMEDIATELY ADJACENT IL. SUCH DEVELOPMENT SHOULD BE AIDED BY AT LEAST A GLANCING/WEAK LOW-AMPLITUDE TROUGH MOVING FROM PARTS OF THE EASTERN DAKOTAS INTO MN. ON THE EAST/NORTHEAST PERIPHERY OF AN EASTWARD-ADVECTING ELEVATED MIXED-LAYER SAMPLED BY THE 12Z OMAHA OBSERVED SOUNDING...THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE ESPECIALLY ACROSS THE SOUTHERN HALF OF IA AND ADJACENT PARTS OF NORTHERN MO AND WEST/NORTHWEST IL WHERE 3000+ J/KG MLCAPE CAN BE EXPECTED. BUOYANCY/DESTABILIZATION WILL BE MORE TEMPERED FARTHER NORTH INTO MN/WI TO THE NORTH OF THE RESIDUAL MORNI

sections.title: CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TO MID-ATLANTIC COAST/DELMARVA
sections.text: THE REMNANTS OF BILL...CENTERED OVER EASTERN KY LATE THIS MORNING...ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO PROGRESS/MODESTLY ACCELERATE EASTWARD TOWARD/ACROSS THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS THROUGH EVENING...AND REACH THE MID-ATLANTIC COAST/DELMARVA VICINITY BY EARLY SUNDAY. REGIONAL 12Z UPPER-AIR OBSERVATIONS AND MORE CONTEMPORARY DERIVED WIND DATA SHOW THAT AN ENHANCED SOUTH-SOUTHWESTERLY LOW/MID-LEVEL WIND FIELD REMAINS ON THE IMMEDIATE EASTERN PERIPHERY OF BILL. WITH AMPLE DOWNSTREAM INSOLATION OCCURRING AT MIDDAY ACROSS PORTIONS OF WV/VA/CAROLINAS...STORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY DEVELOP/INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN A MOIST ENVIRONMENT. AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES WILL RANGE FROM 500-1500 J/KG OVER THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND PIEDMONT...TO 1500-2000+ J/KG ALONG TIDEWATER. STRENGTHENING VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT EMBEDDED LINE SEGMENTS AND SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL. THE POTENTIAL FOR TORNADOES WILL ALSO EXIST...PARTICULARLY NEAR A WEST-EAST FRONT THAT PRECEDES BILL AND/OR AS LOW-LEVEL WINDS STRENGTHEN LATE TODAY INTO EVENING NEAR/EAST OF THE APPALACHIANS.

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: THIS REGION IS LOCATED ON THE SRN PERIPHERY OF A BELT OF STRONG MID-LEVEL FLOW WHICH WILL REMAIN CONFINED TO THE NRN TIER OF STATES THROUGH SUNDAY MORNING. A RESERVOIR OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE CHARACTERIZED BY SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S WILL ACT TO PARTIALLY OFFSET THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING THIS EVENING. ONGOING CLUSTER OF ORGANIZED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS OVER THE MID MS VALLEY WILL LIKELY MOVE ESEWD THIS EVENING OWING TO DEEP WLY TROPOSPHERIC FLOW. THE PRIMARY THREAT WILL LIKELY BE DMGG WINDS AS THE CLUSTER CONTINUES TO GROW UPSCALE THIS EVENING BUT LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE INTO THE MID EVENING HOURS BEFORE A GRADUAL DECREASE IN STORM INTENSITY OWING TO LESSENING BUOYANCY.

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: AN AREA OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE WILL MIGRATE EWD TONIGHT FROM THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS TO NJ BY DAYBREAK SUNDAY. A BAROCLINIC ZONE DRAPED ACROSS THE SERN PA INTO NJ WILL LIKELY SERVE AS A NRN DELIMITER FOR THE STRONG TO SEVERE STORM RISK THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT. A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND A VEERING/STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL WIND PROFILE WILL SUPPORT AN ORGANIZED STRONG TO SEVERE STORM RISK WELL INTO THE EVENING AND PERHAPS LINGERING INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. THE PRIMARY DMGG WIND RISK WILL LIKELY ASSOCIATE WITH EMBEDDED LEWPS/BOWS WITHIN AN EXTENSIVE LINEAR SYSTEM AS IT PROGRESSES EWD THIS EVENING ACROSS THE MID ATLANTIC STATES.

sections.title: BLACK HILLS REGION
sections.text: RELATIVELY MOIST ELY COMPONENT TO THE LOW-LEVEL FLOW LOCATED N OF A FRONT OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS HAS CONTRIBUTED TO MARGINAL TO MODERATE BUOYANCY OVER THE REGION. STRENGTHENING WLY FLOW WITH HEIGHT PER THE 00Z RAP RAOB IS SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS. A GRADUAL DIMINISHING IN ISOLD TO WIDELY SCTD STORM COVERAGE/INTENSITY IS EXPECTED THIS EVENING. ISOLD LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER STORMS. ELSEWHERE...A FEW STRONG STORMS WILL FOCUS ALONG A FRONTAL ZONE OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST/NRN PLAINS THIS EARLY THIS EVENING BEFORE THE SEVERE RISK WANES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..SMITH.. 06/21/2015

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS AT LEAST RELATIVELY SHORT-LIVED/WEAK TORNADOES...IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS MAY BE SOMEWHAT SPOTTY IN THE NEAR TERM...WITH A MORE SUBSTANTIVE INCREASE IN SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL ACROSS THE PIEDMONT CLOSER TO 20-21Z. ONE OR MORE WATCHES PROBABLY WILL BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION IS ALREADY BECOMING SUPPORTIVE OF INCREASING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS AND TO THE IMMEDIATE LEE OF MUCH OF THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS. THIS PROBABLY IS BEING AIDED BY FORCING FOR ASCENT DOWNSTREAM OF THE MID-LEVEL REMNANTS OF TROPICAL STORM BILL. A BELT OF CYCLONIC/WEST SOUTHWESTERLY MID TROPOSPHERIC FLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE IS ALREADY NOSING ACROSS THE MOUNTAINS INTO THE PIEDMONT OF THE CAROLINAS AND SOUTHERN VIRGINIA. AS THIS CONTINUES...A GRADUAL CORRESPONDING STRENGTHENING OF SOUTHERLY 850 MB FLOW IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE SAME REGION THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...SLOWLY SPREADING EASTWARD. AS THIS FORCING...AND STRENGTHENING/INCREASINGLY SHEARED LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC FLOW FIELDS...BEGIN TO INTERACT WITH HIGHER MOISTURE CONTENT AIR /CHARACTERIZED BY SURFACE DEW POINTS AT OR ABOVE 70F/ ALONG AND TO THE EAST OF THE LEE SURFACE TROUGH...A MORE SUBSTANTIVE RISK FOR SEVERE STORMS IS EXPECTED TO MATERIALIZE. THIS SEEMS MOSTLY LIKELY CLOSER TO OR AFTER 20-21Z...AND WILL INCLUDE THE RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE WIND GUSTS...PERHAPS AT LEAST RELATIVELY SHORT-LIVED/BRIEF TORNADOES...PARTICULARLY NEAR A WEAK WARM FRONTAL ZONE EXTENDING ACROSS THE EASTERN WEST VIRGINIA PANHANDLE AND WESTERN/NORTHERN MARYLAND INTO SOUTH CENTRAL PENNSYLVANIA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WITH MARGINALLY SEVERE MAY PERSIST THIS AFTERNOON...AND A GREATER THREAT OF SEVERE MAY EMERGE LATER THIS AFTERNOON ESPECIALLY ACROSS CENTRAL/SOUTHERN IOWA. A WW WILL LIKELY NOT BE NEEDED IN THE SHORT-TERM...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POTENTIAL INCREASING THREAT LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS ONGOING ACROSS CENTRAL AND EASTERN IOWA HAVE BEEN MARGINALLY SEVERE WITH OCCASIONAL REPORTS OF 1 INCH HAIL REPORTED WITHIN THE LAST TWO HOURS. THESE STORMS ARE CURRENTLY ELEVATED ATOP A SHALLOW LAYER OF RAIN-COOLED AIR LEFT BEHIND FROM PREVIOUS MORNING CONVECTION. THIS CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THROUGHOUT THE DAY...FORCED BY SUSTAINED CONVERGENCE AROUND 850 MB AND A FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILE WITH SUFFICIENT MID-LEVEL INSTABILITY. OCCASIONAL LARGE HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO BE THE MAIN THREAT WITH STRONGER CELLS...BUT THE MARGINALITY AND SPORADIC NATURE OF THE THREAT WILL LIKELY PRECLUDE A WW ISSUANCE FOR THIS ACTIVITY IN THE SHORT TERM. LATER THIS AFTERNOON...MODEL GUIDANCE AND OBSERVATIONS SUGGEST THE POSSIBILITY OF MORE SURFACE-BASED STORMS DEVELOPING ALONG A COLD FRONT ENTERING NORTHWESTERN IOWA...WITH DEVELOPMENT ALSO POSSIBLE ALONG A DIFFERENTIAL HEATING/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTING THAT FRONT FROM NEAR SPW TO NEAR DSM TO NEAR BRL. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR NEAR AND NORTH/EAST OF THIS BOUNDARY IS HIGHER DUE TO BACKED LOW-LEVEL WINDS...AND ALTHOUGH CURRENT CONVECTION IS LIKELY NOT REALIZING THE ENHANCED SHEAR DUE TO THEIR ELEVATED NATURE...ANY SURFACE BASED ACTIVITY THAT DEVELOPS LATER THIS AFTERNOON MAY REALIZE THE INCREASED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WHILE ALSO FORMING IN A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...POSING A GREATER SEVERE THREAT. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED LATER ONCE THE DETAILS OF THIS POTENTIAL ACTIVITY BECOME CLEARER LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: FURTHER INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS ACROSS THE GEORGIA INTO SOUTH CAROLINA PIEDMONT MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY THE RISK FOR AT LEAST LOCALIZED POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. THE NEED FOR A WATCH STILL APPEARS UNLIKELY...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MODERATE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION HAS CONTRIBUTED TO INCREASING THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT NEAR/SOUTH THROUGH EAST OF THE GREATER ATLANTA METROPOLITAN AREA. THIS IS GENERALLY ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF THE CYCLONIC FLOW FIELDS ASSOCIATED WITH THE REMNANTS OF TROPICAL STORM BILL...WHERE WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW IS ONLY A RATHER MODEST 20 KT OR SO. HOWEVER...THIS WILL AID CONTINUED PROPAGATION ACROSS THE PIEDMONT OF GEORGIA INTO SOUTH CAROLINA...WHERE THE BOUNDARY LAYER BECOMES INCREASINGLY STRONGLY HEATED AND DEEPLY MIXED WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE LOWER TO MID 90S. WHILE THE PRONOUNCED WESTERLY COMPONENT TO THE LOW-LEVEL FLOW AHEAD OF CONVECTION IS ALSO NOT OPTIMAL...THE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES APPEAR FAVORABLE FOR AT LEAST LOCALIZED STRONG WIND GUSTS WITH ANY SUSTAINED CONVECTION. IT ALSO APPEARS POSSIBLE THAT OUTFLOW EMANATING FROM ONGOING STRENGTHENING/CONSOLIDATING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS UPSTATE SOUTH CAROLINA COULD PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS EMERGING FROM GEORGIA LATER THIS AFTERNOON...AS STORMS TRACK EAST NORTHEASTWARD ALONG IT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INTENSIFYING THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS POSSIBLE ACROSS THE INTERIOR FLORIDA PENINSULA BY AROUND 21-22Z...MAINLY SOUTH OF ORLANDO. IN ADDITION TO LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL AND FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING...ONE OR TWO MICROBURSTS MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: COLLIDING SEA BREEZE FRONTS...PERHAPS ENHANCED BY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW...APPEAR LIKELY TO LEAD TO INTENSIFYING THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY OVER THE INTERIOR PENINSULA...PARTICULARLY SOUTH OF ORLANDO INTO AREAS NORTHWEST OF LAKE OKEECHOBEE. STRONG HEATING INTO THE MID 90S HAS OCCURRED ACROSS THIS AREA...CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATELY LARGE CAPE SUPPORTIVE OF VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. IN THE PRESENCE OF SEASONABLY HIGH PRECIPITABLE WATER CONTENT /2+ INCHES/...HEAVY PRECIPITATION LOADING AUGMENTED BY SUB-CLOUD EVAPORATIVE COOLING COULD GENERATE ONE OR TWO MICROBURSTS WITH LOCALIZED...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ELEVATED CONVECTION CONTINUES OVER EASTERN IOWA...WITH ADDITIONAL CONVECTION LIKELY TO DEVELOP ACROSS A COLD FRONT IN CENTRAL IOWA. WITH INCREASING DESTABILIZATION AND CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT APPEARING LIKELY TO OCCUR...A TORNADO WATCH WILL BE ISSUED BY 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ELEVATED CONVECTION HAS PERSISTED ACROSS EASTERN IOWA THROUGHOUT THE DAY...PRODUCING SPORADIC INSTANCES OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND SUB-SEVERE WIND GUSTS. TO THE WEST OF THIS CONVECTION...STRONG CAPPING AND STRONG INSOLATION HAS ALLOWED FOR A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT TO DEVELOP WITH 3000-4000 J/KG MLCAPE. VEERED SURFACE FLOW IN WESTERN PARTS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA HAVE LESSENED THE MAGNITUDE OF LOW-LEVEL SHEAR...BUT 0-3KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITY VALUES AROUND 250 M2/S2 INDICATED ON LATEST WSR-88D WIND PROFILER AT DMX SUGGESTS THE ENVIRONMENT WILL HAVE SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR STORM ROTATION AND A TORNADO THREAT IN SURFACE BASED STORMS. LATEST HIGH-RESOLUTION MODEL GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO SUGGEST AN INCREASE IN SURFACE-BASED CONVECTION ALONG SEWD MOVING COLD FRONT IN IOWA...AND DAMAGING WINDS...SIGNIFICANT HAIL...AND TORNADOES ARE ALL POSSIBLE AS CONVECTION MATERIALIZES. A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED BY 21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER NORTH CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA THIS AFTERNOON...WITH A MARGINAL THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL LIKELY WITH THE STRONGEST CELLS. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER NORTH CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA...WITH A COUPLE OF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES NOTED WITHIN THE PAST HOUR. THE STORMS ARE IN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE AND 30-35 KNOT DEEP SHEAR MARGINALLY FAVORABLE FOR STORM ORGANIZATION. DESPITE THE RELATIVELY WEAK DEEP SHEAR...LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL PROFILES AND RELATIVELY STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS HAVE FAVORED SPLITTING SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED INSTANCES OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE PRIMARY THREATS. THESE STORMS MAY PERSIST FOR A FEW HOURS TOWARD EVENING...BUT ARE EXPECTED TO WEAKEN TOWARD SUNSET COINCIDENT WITH NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION. GIVEN THE BRIEF AND ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT...A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS WESTERN SOUTH DAKOTA...WITH A GRADUAL UPTICK IN THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE EXPECTED THROUGH THE EVENING. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS NORTHWESTERN AND FAR WEST CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA...AND A FEW TOWERING CU ARE NOTED VIA SATELLITE IMAGERY OVER ADJACENT AREAS OF NORTHEASTERN WYOMING. SURFACE TEMPERATURES RISING THROUGH THE 70S AND LOWER 80S HAVE ALLOWED FOR WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY TO DEVELOP IN THE DISCUSSION AREA...WITH 500-1500 J/KG MLCAPE NOTED IN THE DISCUSSION AREA. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELDS ARE WEAK AND ONLY CONTAIN A VERY SLIGHT UPSLOPE COMPONENT...50-KNOT MID-LEVEL FLOW ALOFT OVER THE AREA IS CONTRIBUTING TO SUBSTANTIAL DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR STORM ORGANIZATION. OBSERVATIONS AND MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGEST A GRADUAL INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT THROUGH THE EVENING...WITH ENOUGH SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT TO WARRANT CONSIDERATION OF A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PARTS OF SERN PA...NJ...DE...AND ERN MD ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE NEW WATCH. MEANWHILE...PRIMARY THREAT OF DMGG WIND GUSTS CONTINUES WITHIN SVR TSTM WATCHES 317 AND 318 OVER THE MID-ATLANTIC INTO NRN NC.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS SMALL LINE SEGMENTS DEVELOPING ALONG/AHEAD OF MAIN CONFLUENCE LINE ACCOMPANYING SFC LOW MOVING ACROSS ERN WV. MORE ISOLATED/DISCRETE DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING FARTHER E FROM NRN VA INTO ERN MD...INVOF A DIFFUSE WARM FRONT DRAPED ACROSS SRN PA INTO SRN NJ. THE WIND THREAT SHOULD REMAIN DOMINANT WITHIN MUCH OF THE WARM SECTOR ACROSS VA INTO NRN NC...GIVEN PREFERRED STORM MODE OF SMALL LINE SEGMENTS AND SLY/GRADUALLY VEERING LOW-LEVEL FLOW OBSERVED IN REGIONAL VWP DATA. HOWEVER...A TORNADO THREAT CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITH DISCRETE TSTMS INTERACTING WITH THE WARM FRONT WHERE SFC WINDS ARE EXHIBITING A MORE ELY COMPONENT. DMGG WIND AND WEAK TORNADO THREAT COULD EXTEND TO THE E OF SVR TSTM WATCH 317 OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS AS THE WARM FRONT ADVANCES NWD...BUT RECENT CONVECTIVE TRENDS SHOW ONGOING TSTMS MOVING INTO NRN DE ARE STRUGGLING TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY. HOWEVER...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A NEW POSSIBLE WW...WHICH MAY INCLUDE PARTS OF SERN PA...NJ...DE...AND ERN MD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: UPWARD EVOLVING SQUALL LINE WILL PROPAGATE SEWD ACROSS WW319.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOW-LEVEL FLOW HAS VEERED CONSIDERABLY AHEAD OF SFC COLD FRONT THAT EXTENDS FROM ECNTRL IA...SWWD INTO NWRN MO. CONVECTION HAS GRADUALLY INCREASED ALONG THIS WIND SHIFT OVER THE LAST FEW HOURS AND APPEARS TO BE TAKING ON MORE LINEAR CHARACTERISTICS THAN DISCRETE. INSTABILITY IS QUITE STRONG SOUTH OF THE FRONT AND DEEP LAYER SHEAR SUFFICIENT FOR MAINTAINING ORGANIZED CONVECTION. GIVEN THE CURRENT TRENDS...IT APPEARS AN EXPANDING LINEAR MCS MAY ULTIMATELY EVOLVE ALONG THE FRONT THEN PROPAGATE SEWD TOWARD NWRN IL. LARGE HAIL IS LIKELY OBSERVED WITH ACTIVITY OVER MONROE COUNTY IA BUT DAMAGING WINDS COULD MATERIALIZE IF BOWING STRUCTURES ULTIMATELY EVOLVE. ..DARROW.. 06/20/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED SOON TO ACCOUNT FOR UPSTREAM MCS MOVING INTO THE REGION. THE PRIMARY THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE DMGG WIND GUSTS...ALTHOUGH A BRIEF/WEAK TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONGEALING LINE OF TSTMS ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC IS PROGRESSING NEWD AT AROUND 35 KT...AND SHOULD REACH SERN PA INTO THE CHESAPEAKE BAY BETWEEN 0100-0130Z. GIVEN CONVECTIVE MODE...PRIMARY THREAT WILL LIKELY REMAIN DMGG WINDS...BUT TRANSIENT EMBEDDED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AND ASSOCIATED POTENTIAL FOR A WEAK/BRIEF TORNADO SHOULD CONTINUE FOR THE NEXT FEW HRS...ESPECIALLY INVOF SELY WINDS OBSERVED ACROSS NRN PARTS OF THE DELMARVA PENINSULA INTO NJ/SERN PA. A NEW WW WILL LIKELY BE PROPOSED SOON FOR PARTS OF SERN PA...SRN/CNTRL NJ...DE...AND ERN MD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS SHOULD CONTINUE IN THE SHORT-TERM INTO N-CNTRL NEB. A WW IS NOT IMMINENT...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF INCREASING TSTM COVERAGE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LONG-LIVED DISCRETE SUPERCELL ENTERING SHERIDAN COUNTY NEB CONTINUES TO EXHIBIT LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUST POTENTIAL AS IT MOVES SEWD. LBF 00Z SOUNDING SAMPLED A STEEP LAPSE RATE PROFILE AND 40-50 KT OF MIDLEVEL FLOW...BUT WEAK ELY FLOW IN THE LOW-LEVELS. THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT IS MARGINAL...CHARACTERIZED BY AROUND 1000 J/KG OF MLCAPE. WITH THE IMMINENT LOSS OF DIURNAL HEAT...AND AN UNCLEAR FOCUS FOR TSTM PERSISTENCE...IT IS UNCERTAIN HOW LONG-LIVED THE ASSOCIATED SVR THREAT WILL PERSIST. HOWEVER...AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY EXIST FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT HR...AND PERHAPS LONGER IF ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT CAN OCCUR...IN WHICH CASE A WW MAY BE CONSIDERED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS CONTINUES TO ACCOMPANY TSTM LINE MOVING ACROSS ERN MD SWD INTO NERN NC. WW 318 WILL LIKELY BE LOCALLY EXTENDED ACROSS PARTS OF SERN VA AND NERN NC.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BROKEN LINE OF TSTMS WITH EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS CONTINUES TO PROGRESS IN A GENERAL E-NEWD DIRECTION AT AROUND 35 KT...AND THE PRIMARY THREAT REMAINS STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS. DIURNAL COOLING SHOULD RESULT IN SOME DECREASE IN INSTABILITY OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS...ALTHOUGH THIS WILL BE LIMITED BY THE HIGH DEWPOINTS IN THE AREA. HOWEVER...A GRADUAL DECREASE IN INTENSITY SEEMS PROBABLE AS TSTMS APPROACH THE ATLANTIC COAST. EXTRAPOLATION OF SRN PORTION OF THE LINE ACROSS THE TIDEWATER OF VA AND NERN NC SUGGESTS TSTMS WILL NOT REACH THE COAST BY WATCH EXPIRATION TIME OF 03Z...AND A LOCAL WATCH EXTENSION OF WW 318 IS LIKELY ACROSS THESE AREAS. ..ROGERS.. 06/21/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY INTO THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. HAIL AND WIND ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS. SEVERE TSTM WATCH 321 HAS BEEN ISSUED DOWNSTREAM FOR THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS HAS MATURED OVER THE MID MS VALLEY LATE THIS EVENING. LEADING EDGE OF STRONGER SURGE IS PROPAGATING SEWD AT ROUGHLY 40KT AS IT PROGRESSES THROUGH CNTRL IL. TRAILING FLANK HAS STALLED ALONG THE IA/MO BORDER AS VEERED LLJ IMPINGES ON BACK SIDE OF CONVECTION. GIVEN THE DECOUPLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER IT APPEARS WARM ADVECTION MAY CONTINUE TO DRIVE ADDITIONAL UPDRAFTS ACROSS SCNTRL IA/NRN MO FOR SEVERAL HOURS. ..DARROW.. 06/21/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG STORMS WILL SPREAD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW321 BY 0630Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING EDGE OF MCS IS PROPAGATING SEWD AT ROUGHLY 40KT. CURRENT SPEED/MOVEMENT SUGGESTS STRONGEST ACTIVITY WILL EXIT ERN PORTIONS OF WATCH BY 0630Z. GUSTY WINDS AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS. ..DARROW.. 06/21/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A NOTABLE INCREASE IN TSTMS HAS BEEN OBSERVED OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS FROM CAMPBELL AND CROOK COUNTIES WY THROUGH THE BLACK HILLS TO SHANNON...BENNETT AND TODD COUNTIES IN SWRN AND S-CNTRL SD. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY AND NEAR-TERM MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGEST THAT PERHAPS A LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED 50-60 KT MID-LEVEL JET MAY BE ACTING IN CONCERT WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA /PER RAPID CITY VAD/ TO FORCE THIS ACTIVITY. BASED ON CURRENT RAP-BASED OBJECTIVE DATA AND 00Z RAPID CITY AND NORTH PLATTE SOUNDINGS...IT APPEARS THAT THE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE AT LEAST FOR MOST-UNSTABLE PARCELS. AND GIVEN THE STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR PRESENT...THE SETUP IS SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. THE PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY IS THE DURATION OF THIS SEVERE WEATHER THREAT...GIVEN THE TIME OF DAY. ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS SHOULD REMAIN POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH STORMS GRADUALLY SPREADING SEWD INTO PARTS OF N-CNTRL NEB. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR THE EVOLUTION OF A MORE ORGANIZED WIND THREAT THAT WOULD NECESSITATE A WATCH. ..MEAD.. 06/21/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS CENTRAL PORTIONS OF INDIANA AS A LINE OF STORMS ADVANCES TO THE ESE TOWARD SOUTHEAST INDIANA AND EXTREME SWRN OH THROUGH 08Z. NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD CONTINUE TO OCCUR ON THE SOUTHERN FLANK...THOUGH OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH BEYOND 07Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED SOME DECELERATION OF THE LINE OF STORMS MOVING THROUGH CENTRAL IND...THOUGH A FORWARD SPEED AT 35-40 KT CAN STILL PRODUCE LOCALLY STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. IN ADDITION TO THE DECELERATION IN FORWARD SPEED...IR IMAGERY SHOWED GRADUAL WARMING CLOUD TOPS WITH THIS MCS ACROSS THE MIDWEST. HIGH-RES MODELS SUPPORT THE OVERALL OBSERVED WEAKENING TRENDS WITH THE ONGOING LINE OF STORMS UNDERGOING FURTHER WEAKENING AS IT APPROACHES THE SOUTHEAST IND/SOUTHWEST OH BORDER REGION BY 08Z. PRIOR TO 07-08Z...A LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUST CANNOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS CENTRAL IND BEFORE THIS MCS UNDERGOES FURTHER DECAY. ..PETERS.. 06/21/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ELEVATED TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP DURING THE OVERNIGHT INTO EARLY THIS MORNING ACROSS NORTHEAST TO EAST-CENTRAL MO AND PARTS OF WEST-CENTRAL TO SOUTHWEST IL. A MAJORITY OF THE STORMS SHOULD REMAIN SUB-SEVERE...THOUGH ISOLATED HAIL APPROACHING 1 INCH IN DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ONGOING STORMS MOVING ESEWD FROM NORTHEAST MO INTO ADJACENT WRN IL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MESOANALYSES AND RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A COMPOSITE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM FAR SRN INDIANA SWWD INTO FAR SRN IL INTO SERN MO /SRN PERRY COUNTY/...WITH THIS BOUNDARY THEN EXTENDING NWWD THROUGH CENTRAL MO /WEST OF KCOU/ TO THE KANSAS CITY METRO. A WAA REGIME LOCATED ACROSS NRN AND ERN MO WITHIN THE NOSE OF A 40-KT WLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO NRN MO FROM KS WILL CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH THE SHORT-TERM /UNTIL 10-11Z/ ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF THE MID MS VALLEY MCS. THE ERN EXTENT OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /7-8 C/KM IN THE 700-500-MB LAYER/ AND A FEED OF MODERATE INSTABILITY INTO THE SWRN FLANK SUGGEST SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY REMAINS FOR NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT FROM NERN MO INTO ADJACENT WRN IL OVERNIGHT. TRENDS IN SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED PERSISTENT CLOUD TOP COOLING ACROSS THE SWRN FLANK OF THIS MCS WITH THE GOES-R OVERSHOOTING TOP PRODUCT SUGGESTING CONTINUED STRONG UPDRAFTS OCCURRING OVER NERN MO /CHARITON TO RALLS COUNTIES MO/. STRONGEST BULK SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN OVER NRN MO...SUCH THAT ANY ELEVATED STORM ORGANIZATION SHOULD BE WITH THE ONGOING STORMS...WITH LESS ORGANIZATION POSSIBLE AS STORMS MOVE INTO EAST-CENTRAL MO AND ADJACENT SOUTHWEST IL BY 11Z.
